a11y.stage_report: A photo is taken, a category is chosen, and a pin lands on the map. The report is submitted.
a11y.stage_track: Report pins in different category colors land on a neighborhood map. One report's status moves from Published to In progress to Resolved.
a11y.stage_together: A cleanup event card with neighbors going, a short chat between two neighbors, and a profile with a username.
a11y.stage_theme: A preview card in the look you picked, with a report pin.
a11y.stage_ready: Your profile avatar and username placeholder.

report.title: See it. Snap it. Pin it.
report.body: Photo, what it is, where it is. Three taps and your report is on the map.
report.caption: Emergency? Call 911. civfix is not for emergencies.

track.title: Your block, live.
track.body: Every pin is a neighbor's report. Colors are categories. Tap one to see photos, updates, and the conversation.
track.caption: Browse without an account.

together.title: Show up. Talk it through.
together.body: Join cleanups, claim a shift, log hours. Message neighbors on a report or in a crew chat.
together.caption: RSVP, messages, and hosting need an account.

stage.chat_1: Anyone else see the light out on 6th?
stage.chat_2: Reported it. The pin is on the map.

theme.title: Light, dark, your call.
theme.body: Pick how civfix looks. Light today, dark whenever you want it.
theme.caption: You can change this any time in Settings.

ready.title: Ready when you are.
ready.body: An account gives you a profile neighbors recognize, your reports timeline, messages, and RSVPs. Or just look around first.
ready.body_authed: Report problems, RSVP to cleanups, and message neighbors, right from the map.

trust.nonprofit: Built by Reach Out Los Angeles, a 501(c)(3) non-profit.
trust.tracking: No ads, no analytics, no trackers.
trust.photos: Photos have GPS and camera data removed before upload.

location.title: See what's happening near you?
location.body: Your location centers the map on your block. It is used only while you use the app, and you can report without it.
